Restrict a ledger to part of its time

tl_restrict.Rd

Rows outside keep have their reference state set to "unknown", with the reason recorded in ref_reason. Because every reference-based metric is computed on reference-known time, this removes the rows from all denominators while leaving them visible for inspection. Durations still add up to the target period.

Usage

tl_restrict(ledger, keep, reason)

Arguments

ledger

A tl_ledger.

keep

Logical vector, one value per ledger row.

reason

Text stored in ref_reason for the excluded rows.

Value

The modified tl_ledger, with the restriction logged in the restrictions attribute.

Examples

fx <- tl_fixture("acceptance")
led <- tl_ledger(fx$records, fx$reference, fx$predictions,
                 time_unit = "min")
late <- tl_restrict(led, led$start >= 50, "before minute 50")
tl_metrics(late, tl_match(late))
